model.description: Relative to the inference declaration; absolute paths are rejected by the interpreter.

modelTracks.description: Raw source axis shared by spectrum and waveform_sources. Declare together with trackMapping. If both are omitted, exports must be the complete official ordered four or six sources and identity mapping is used.

trackMapping.description: Exported track ID -> raw model source name. Keys must exactly match exports.tracks IDs; values must be present in modelTracks. The interpreter enforces these cross-field rules. Result order follows exports.tracks, regardless of object key order.
